title: A Play with Two Pairs of Hands
youtube_title: A Play with Two Pairs of Hands | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork is planning together and pausing when you disagree.
summary: Nura and Oona use sock puppets to tell about a bridge and a pretend river. When a plank is placed in the deep part, they pause, use real voices, and choose a better spot together. The picnic crosses, and the puppets rest finished on the sill.
